title: It's time to reassess the size of our solar system, scientists say
caption:
New math suggests our solar system's gravitational boundary reaches much further than previously thought—nearly 4 light-years out. This shift could change how we hunt for interstellar visitors and rogue planets.

Source: Space - It's time to reassess the size of our solar system, scientists say
